questions_after.question: What are the precise definitions of cash cost, all-in sustaining cost (AISC), all-in cost, and 'excluding third-party buy-in feedstock', and what FX/oz conversion convention is used to translate ZAR/kg cost metrics to US$/oz? Group FY26 AISC prints 985,551 ZAR/kg and 1,867 US$/oz; 985,551/16.90/32.1507 ≈ 1,814 US$/oz (residual ~53 US$/oz), and cash cost 860,706 ZAR/kg vs 1,600 US$/oz (residual ~16 US$/oz).
questions_after.target_section: D008 Alternative performance measures (pp. 38-47); D010 Glossary (pp. 51-52)
questions_after.evidence_required: Definition of each cost metric, treatment of third-party buy-in feedstock, and the exact FX rate and oz/kg conversion (32.1507 vs other) used; period FY26 and FY25; units ZAR/kg and US$/oz.
questions_after.closure_condition: Definitions and conversion convention stated, and the ZAR/kg-to-US$/oz residuals for Group cash cost and AISC explained (or confirmed as rounding/convention).

questions_after.question: Is the Tennant A$ all-in cost FY25 figure of 1,584,835 A$/kg a printing/scale error? FY26 prints 205,143 A$/kg, a ~7.7x swing inconsistent with A$ cash cost (43,116 to 81,099) and AISC (80,962 to 106,900) moves.
questions_after.evidence_required: Restated or corrected Tennant A$ all-in cost for FY25 and FY26, with units A$/kg and the underlying A$ all-in cost of production (A$m) and oz produced.
questions_after.closure_condition: Correct FY25 Tennant A$ all-in cost confirmed, or the printed figure confirmed with explanation of the swing.

questions_after.question: Why does FY25 Group gold produced not reconcile? Sum of components (93,724 + 2,654 + 98,636 + 1,081 + 1,513) = 197,608 oz vs printed Group total 196,527 oz (residual +1,081 oz); Evander underground shows 26,748 oz in the mining-operations block but 27,829 oz in the Evander Mines total column (difference 1,081 oz = buy-in oz).
questions_after.evidence_required: Segment gold-produced reconciliation for FY25 by asset, clarifying whether buy-in feedstock oz are included in the Evander underground column or only in the total column.
questions_after.closure_condition: Column scope confirmed and FY25 Group total reconciled to components (or residual explained).
